concepts.title: Quiet atelier
concepts.detail: Fine champagne rails, softened ruby glass and calm proportions.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: ONE complete sophisticated game main-menu screenshot, 1672x941 landscape. Input image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET.
USER REQUEST: take this ruby-and-gold menu, make it a bit more sophisticated, and make its panel BOTH LONGER/TALLER AND WIDER. This is a refinement of this selected design, not an unrelated menu family.

Use the larger area for generous internal side margins and expanded vertical spacing. Keep the complete border inside the canvas and well away from the mannequin. This is a flat screen-space UI, not a physical object in the scene.
KEEP THE DESIGN DNA: one enclosed portrait RECTANGLE; translucent deep ruby/black interior showing the crimson water through its lower part; pale champagne-gold precision frame; bright warm ivory lettering; five actions in one centered top-to-bottom list. EXACT TEXT, top-to-bottom, once each: "CONTINUE", "NEW GAME", "LOAD GAME", "SETTINGS", "QUIT". Continue selected. All text bright and readable. No random lettering, ultra-thin stretched glyphs, duplicated characters or very wide artificial tracking. Spread rows through the extended panel with balanced top and bottom margins.
LOCK EVERYTHING OUTSIDE THE UI: identical original camera, crop, 1672x941 composition, black void, grey mannequin pose, position, proportions, silhouette and neutral lighting; identical crimson marbled watery ground, ripples, foot rings and white reflected-light positions/intensities.
